instrument.model: SDS800X HD series (SDS802X HD / SDS804X HD / SDS810X HD / SDS814X HD / SDS824X HD)

source.operation: raw TCP SCPI session, capture and waveform download, measurement readback, screenshot readback, decode list readback, offline waveform analysis and evidence reporting
source.transport: raw TCP port 5025 (exercised on hardware); legacy shell port 5024 is not used

manual.title: SDS800XHD Series Programming Guide
manual.revision: CN11G (see the manual cover; the index cites PDF physical pages)

capture.note: capture manifests are produced per run; no single capture is committed with this Skill

data.raw_provenance: no fixture is committed: captures are produced by scripts/capture_scope.py and analysed offline; the analysis path is exercised by the bundled offline tests only

support.scope_note: hardware_verified covers the session, capture, waveform download and :MEASure paths only. The :PRINt? reader, waveform_evidence.py and the decode-list reader are documented and offline-tested, not exercised on a physical instrument.

hardware_evidence.note: the per-claim table is in SUPPORT.md; no single date covers every claim

known_limitations: Voltage reconstructed from codes can be wrong while the structure status still reads VALID: a reply from another channel is accepted as this channel's V/div (scope_protocol.py query_ascii does not verify the echo prefix), an ampere scale is reported as volts (_UNIT_SCALES maps A to 1.0 and units are hardcoded), a legacy capture never reads the panel offset, and code_per_div is only checked for >0. Five paths reproduced offline in artifacts/check-waveform/report.md.
No cross-check against the instrument's own :MEASure PKPK/TOP/BASE existed at the time of this record, so 'the scale is usable' was conflated with 'the level is confirmed'.

Eleven silent-accept paths: unparseable WAV:STAR? readback does not block segment validation, legacy DAT2 writes a manifest and exits 0 without descriptor validation, validate_frame falls back to ACQ:POIN? in same_record mode, and the decode list reports likely_complete for a header-only reply. See artifacts/check-integrity/report.md.
Probe ratio is never read back (:CHANnel<n>:PROBe? is called nowhere), so vdiv_with_probe is unverified.
Offset sign and the offset*probe direction have no non-zero hardware reply, so they stay UNVERIFIED.
No voltage calibration was performed; derived levels are OBSERVED_UNVERIFIED at best.
The :PRINt? PNG reader and waveform_evidence.py are documented and offline-tested only.
Status words are reused across claims: VALID proves descriptor-versus-panel self-consistency, never an absolute voltage.

evidence.reason: no capture fixture is committed with this Skill
no instrument-measurement cross-check was implemented; five wrong-level paths reproduced offline

limitations: Voltages, thresholds and levels are not confirmed against a traceable reference.
